bio.text: Jim Baird represents Indiana's 4th District in the U.S. House and serves on the Agriculture, Foreign Affairs, and Science, Space, and Technology committees.
Before Congress he served eight years in the Indiana House of Representatives and was a county commissioner.
He served in the Vietnam War and received a Bronze Star with V device and two Purple Hearts.

He earned bachelor's and master's degrees in animal science from Purdue University and a doctorate in monogastric nutrition from the University of Kentucky, and is a lifelong resident of west central Indiana.
